links.outcome: Reliance on auto-contours and automation bias risk after system implementation
links.effect: Adoption was associated with increased reliance on automated settings (higher DSC and lower HD95 between auto and final contours postimplementation for several OARs and targets), indicating potential automation bias.
links.quote: In our study, the adoption of an auto-contouring system was associated with an increased reliance on automated settings, underscoring its utility and the potential risk of automation bias.

links.outcome: Extent to which clinician review and revision changed AI auto-contours
links.effect: Reviewers revised auto-contours (final contours generally larger, more slices), but agreement between auto and final contours rose postimplementation, and lung segmentation was inaccurate. Analyzed 22,215 structures.
links.quote: The final contours were generally larger, encompassing more slices in the superior or inferior directions.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world clinical implementation of deep learning auto-contouring in breast radiation therapy across >2,000 cases, investigating clinicians' manual review, adjustment, and potential automation bias.

primary.practice: manual multidisciplinary review and adjustment of auto-contours
